name: Affirmative cyber formations
description: Short-lived futuristic formations applied to ordinary commercial and social network activity.
cause_of_death: Affirmative formations were displaced by e- forms and ordinary online descriptions; security vocabulary remained productive.

sources.title: Where does the word cyber come from?
sources.note: Oxford Dictionaries retrospective distinguishes displaced affirmative formations from continuing security terminology.
